topic.title: Installing the License Server Distribution for Windows

ol.li: Download the appropriate license server installer from the Oxygen License Server website.
Run the installer and follow the on-screen instructions.

You must configure two sets of credentials:
Administrator credentials - Used to access the Oxygen license server administrative interface.
Standard user credentials - Used by an Oxygen application to connect to the license server.

You can change the default port 8080 that the server runs on. If you need to change the port after installation, you can edit the following vmoptions file: oXygen HTTP License Server\Windows Service\oXygenHTTPLicenseServer.vmoptions.
Optionally, you can install the server as a Windows service. If you do, you can choose the name of the Windows service.

p.note: If you run into issues, the license server log file is located at: [Installation_Directory]\work\logs\oXygenLicenseServlet.log.

section.title: HTTPS Support
section.p: The All-Platform Distribution of the License Server does not provide a way to use HTTPS (TLS). If you need HTTPS, you should install the License Server WAR Distribution on Tomcat (10.x required). See the WAR Distribution HTTPS Support section for more details.
